findings.summary: R2/R3 require typed, versioned repo_context.json and workspace_context.json schemas, but the candidate package (as provided) includes only requirement statements and acceptance-test procedures—no actual schema artifacts/versions are specified or referenced in milestones/deliverables, so the trace for “define … schema” is incomplete in this sample.

evidence.note: R2 states schema must be defined/typed/versioned but no schema artifact is present in provided package
R3 states schema must be defined/typed/versioned but no schema artifact is present in provided package
M1 deliverables mention validated repo_context/workspace_context but do not include deliverables for the schemas themselves

findings.summary: R3 says workspace_context.json is required before any workspace-writing stage begins, but tool policy for Intake allows workspace_write (non-canonical) while also listing missing workspace_context as a HITL trigger. This creates ambiguity about whether any workspace writes can occur prior to workspace_context validation.

evidence.note: R3: workspace_context required before any workspace-writing stage begins
Intake HITL trigger includes missing workspace_context.json

findings.summary: Sample check links R1/R2/R3 to milestones M1 and M2, but the enforcement evidence for these requirements appears confined to Intake/WorkPlanning (M1). M2 (parallel lanes) exit criteria do not materially add coverage for R1–R3, so the trace linkage to M2 is weak/possibly misleading in this sample.
